items_flat.title_en: Amodei: pace the frontier; Anthropic commits to embedded evaluators
items_flat.title_zh: Amodei：放慢前沿節奏；Anthropic 承諾嵌入第三方評估員
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei published the essay “We Must Pace the Frontier,” arguing labs should slow capability gains so alignment and operational safety can keep up. Anthropic unilaterally committed to give third-party evaluators (e.g. METR) permanent, employee-like access—desks, badges, laptops, and permissions close to internal risk teams—to verify safety practices, report incidents, and assess alignment during training, with only narrow redaction rights. The essay also calls for democratic coordination and a harder global “ladder,” including possible limits on recursive self-improvement.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 執行長 Dario Amodei 發表〈We Must Pace the Frontier〉，主張實驗室應放慢能力躍進，讓對齊與營運安全跟上。Anthropic 單方面承諾讓第三方評估員（例如 METR）取得常設、接近員工級的權限——辦公桌、門禁、公司筆電與近乎內部風險團隊的系統權限——以核實安全措施、通報事件，並在訓練過程評估對齊；僅保留狹窄的安全／法律遮罩權。文中另呼籲民主國家協調，以及更難的全球「階梯」，包括可能限制遞迴自我改進。
items_flat.analysis_en: The concrete change is verifiability, not a freeze: Anthropic is opening training pipelines to outsiders in a way no frontier lab has normalized. Whether “pacing” becomes industry practice depends on contracts, publish rights, and whether governments grant the antitrust cover Amodei wants for rival coordination.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 真正改變的是可驗證性，而非停訓：Anthropic 把訓練管線對外部開放，這是前沿實驗室尚未常態化的做法。「放慢」能否成為產業常態，取決於合約與公開權，以及政府是否提供 Amodei 所求的反壟斷豁免，讓對手能合法協調。
items_flat.quote: Anthropic is unilaterally committing to the first of these steps. We’ll provide third-party evaluators with permanent, employee-level access to our systems…
items_flat.quote_zh: Anthropic 單方面承諾執行第一步：我們將向第三方評估員提供對系統的常設、員工級存取……

items_flat.title_en: Altman: OpenAI will also give independent evaluators employee-like access
items_flat.title_zh: Altman：OpenAI 也將給予獨立評估員接近員工級的存取
items_flat.summary_en: Responding to Amodei’s post, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman wrote that he agrees the industry needs to pace the frontier and that this has been a primary internal discussion in recent weeks. He called independent evaluators with employee-like access “a great idea,” said OpenAI “will do the same,” and promised more details soon. OpenAI did not publish a matching operational spec in this window.
items_flat.summary_zh: 回應 Amodei 貼文，OpenAI 執行長 Sam Altman 寫道他同意產業需要放慢前沿節奏，且這已是 OpenAI 近數週的主要內部討論。他稱給予獨立評估員接近員工級存取是「好主意」，OpenAI「也會這麼做」，並承諾很快公布細節。本窗口內 OpenAI 尚未發布對等的作業規格。
items_flat.analysis_en: An in-kind match from OpenAI turns Anthropic’s unilateral step into a two-lab norm—if the forthcoming details actually include training-time access rather than post-hoc audits. Scope, redaction rights, and which evaluator organizations get badges remain unspecified.
items_flat.analysis_zh: OpenAI 的對等承諾把 Anthropic 的單方面步驟變成兩家實驗室的新常態——前提是後續細節真的包含訓練期存取，而非事後稽核。範圍、遮罩權與哪些評估機構能拿到門禁，目前都未說明。
items_flat.quote: I agree with Dario that we need to pace the frontier. … Committing to having independent evaluators with employee-like access is a great idea, and we will do the same. We’ll have more to share soon.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我同意 Dario：我們需要放慢前沿節奏。……承諾讓獨立評估員擁有接近員工級的存取是好主意，我們也會這麼做。很快會有更多說明。

items_flat.title_en: Musk: “Dario is right” on pacing the frontier
items_flat.title_zh: Musk：「Dario 是對的」——回應放慢前沿節奏
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk quoted Amodei’s pacing essay and wrote “Dario is right.” The post endorses the diagnosis and the call to slow capability growth relative to safeguards; it does not itself commit xAI to embedded evaluators or a training-rate cap.
items_flat.summary_zh: Elon Musk 引用 Amodei 的放慢節奏長文並寫「Dario 是對的」。此貼文背書診斷與「相對安全措施應放慢能力成長」的呼籲；本身並未承諾 xAI 導入嵌入式評估員或設訓練速率上限。
items_flat.analysis_en: A public agreement from xAI’s principal is notable because the lab has competed on release cadence. An endorsement is not an operational commitment; whether xAI matches Anthropic/OpenAI on evaluator access is still open.
items_flat.analysis_zh: xAI 負責人公開附和值得注意，因為該實驗室一向以釋出節奏競爭。背書不是作業承諾；xAI 是否跟進 Anthropic／OpenAI 的評估員存取，仍屬未定。

items_flat.title_en: Grok models begin rolling out in Microsoft Copilot Office apps
items_flat.title_zh: Grok 模型開始導入 Microsoft Copilot 辦公應用
items_flat.summary_en: Microsoft 365 said Grok models from SpaceXAI are rolling out in Copilot in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, starting with a focused release to Microsoft Frontier program customers. CEO Satya Nadella added “More model choice coming to Copilot. Welcome Grok!” Reporting on the rollout notes an admin opt-in for SpaceXAI data handling and that Grok is not available to Frontier customers in the EU, EFTA, and UK during preview.
items_flat.summary_zh: Microsoft 365 表示，SpaceXAI 的 Grok 模型正導入 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 中的 Copilot，先以 Microsoft Frontier 計畫客戶為焦點釋出。執行長 Satya Nadella 寫道：「更多模型選擇進入 Copilot。歡迎 Grok！」相關報導指出，組織需由管理員開啟 SpaceXAI 資料處理設定；預覽期間歐盟、EFTA 與英國的 Frontier 客戶無法使用 Grok。
items_flat.analysis_en: Copilot already hosts OpenAI and Anthropic models; adding Grok makes Microsoft the widest enterprise front door among frontier labs. Which Grok checkpoint ships, how tenant data is handled, and when the preview leaves Frontier-only status remain the operational questions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Copilot 已承載 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 模型；加入 Grok 使微軟成為前沿實驗室中最寬的企業入口。實際上線的 Grok 檢查點、租戶資料如何處理，以及預覽何時走出僅限 Frontier，仍是作業層問題。
items_flat.quote: Grok models from SpaceXAI are rolling out in Copilot in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint—starting with a focused release to customers in the Microsoft Frontier program.
items_flat.quote_zh: SpaceXAI 的 Grok 模型正導入 Word、Excel 與 PowerPoint 中的 Copilot——先以 Microsoft Frontier 計畫客戶為焦點釋出。

No new flagship model shipped.
brief_zh: Amodei 承諾嵌入第三方評估員並提出「放慢前沿」三步計畫；Altman 跟進同等評估員承諾；Musk 稱「Dario 是對的」。微軟開始向 Frontier 客戶在 Word／Excel／PowerPoint 的 Copilot 導入 Grok。本日無新旗艦模型釋出。
